_comment: Carousel slide templates. There are no AI-generated visuals in carousel mode,
so a template IS the entire visual -- this list is the whole look-and-feel
Each entry's `id` maps to `<id>.css` in this folder, layered on top of
_base.css (which owns geometry and the slide DOM; templates own type,
colour and spacing only). Every template's CSS is scoped to
[data-template="<id>"], so the picker can render live thumbnails of all of
them side by side with all stylesheets loaded at once.
Adding a template = one CSS file + one entry here. Nothing else.
Every template is built to hold the SAME copy budget (CAROUSEL_LIMITS in
lib/validate.js), which is what makes switching templates after the copy is
